SPECIFICATION FOR 
PRESS WORKING DIE SETS (BOSS TYPE) 

PART it CENTRE POST SQUARE DIE SETS 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for boss type square die sets with two guide 
posts in central axis. 

2. Principal Dimensions — See Table 1. 

3. Designation 

3.1 A centre post square die set Type A of cast iron having a die space ai x ai = 80 x 80 mm with 
guide posts Type A with round end and having length <= 160 mm and without any guide bushes 
fitted-in shall be designated as: 

Die Set AO80 IS : 9266 ( Part II ) along with Guide Posts AR-19/20 x 160 IS : 7664 

3^2 Die set as above but with guide bushes Type C shall be designated as - 

Die Set AC-SO IS : 9266 ( Part II ) along with Guide Posts AR-19/20 x 1 60 IS 7664 and 
Guide Bushes C 1 9/20 IS ; 81 27 

3.3 A centre post square die set of cast steef having a die space a\ x a± = 80 x 80 mm with guide 
posts Type B with tapered end and length -160 mm and with guide bushes Type A of length A = 
50 mm shall be designated as: 

Die Set AS-S0 IS : 9266 ( Part IP ) along with Guide Posts BT-19/20 x 160 IS : 7664 and 
Guide Bushes A-19/20 x 50 IS : 8127 

4. Material — The top and bottom tool holders shall be of cast iron of grade FG 260 of IS : 210-1978 
' Specification for grey iron castings ( third revision ) ' or cast steel of grade 23-45 of IS : 1030-1974 
' Carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes ( second revision) '. 

5. General Requirements — The top and bottom tool holders shall be free from cracks, burrs and 
pits and shall satisfy for accuracy when tested jn accordance with the Indian Standard Test chart for 
press working die sets ( under preparation ) 

Note — TiH such tinne ihis standard is published the tests shall b& done as agreed between the concerned parties. 

6. Marking 

6.1 The designation and the manufacturer's trade-mark to appear at a prominent place on tool 
holders. 

6.2 fSt Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
